stem:
Leena helps clean freshly threshed rice outdoors on a breezy afternoon. She wants to separate light husk from heavier rice grains.

When can winnowing work?

options.text: When moving air carries the lighter husk farther while heavier grains fall closer.
When the air is still, if she shakes the mixture hard enough.
When the heavier rice grains travel farther in the wind than the light husk.
When the two parts look different in colour, even if they have the same weight.

teacher.key_rationale: Winnowing needs moving air and a weight difference so lighter husk travels farther.
